name: Broadcast Engineering Services
summary: Western Australian broadcast engineering and communications company (Broadcast Engineering Services (Australia) Pty Ltd, Malaga WA); parent/owner of E-Wire, its residential-estate communications division. Listed by OptiComm with Service Elements, Fuze Connect and eWire as a group of estate-network operators.

events.details: Established 2000 (per business listing; ABN 29 066 971 533); ran E-Wire's Perth residential-estate networks.
ABN 29 066 971 533 cancelled 12 Mar 2015; GST cancelled 31 Mar 2014; LinkedIn reports operations terminated Apr 2014. Parent of E-Wire estate FTTH networks (Perth).
